node.title: Re^2: Granular padding peaks in graphs

node.doctext: I'm using gnuplot. It has an offset parameter.. but leaves me with the same problem. PS: I like Ploty.js too! But I tend to make heavy use of fenceplots [https://stackoverflow.com/questions/46096494/gnuplot-alternating-colors-in-fenceplots]
